findingClass: the deploy-failure STATUS row (scripts/deploy-status.mjs) is write-only - written on failure, cleared on the next success, but never read back - so a row can sit open on disk indefinitely with nothing surfacing it
failThreshold: any slot's deploy-failure STATUS row (deploy-failure-status.json) has been open for more than 24h
warnThreshold: a slot's row is open but under 24h old - a normal in-progress-fix window, not yet an outage
unverifiableWhen: the deploy-failure-status.json file exists but could not be read/parsed (an ABSENT file is a legitimate PASS - no deploy has ever failed)
